Dirk

       pr <- pkgbuild_process$new("testDummy", binary = TRUE, dest_path = tmp)

           pr$kill()

       }
       expect_true(file.exists(pr$get_dest_path()))
       expect_true(file.exists(pr$get_built_file()))
